final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) AS byte_rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.byte_rate - b.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_excess FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE m.byte_rate > b.avg_rate
